formation_reference_en: Verb-stem / Noun + がてら
meaning_reference_en: while; on the way; taking the opportunity of
notes_reference_en: One outing serves two purposes; the main clause is usually a movement (行く, 寄る, 歩く). Compare 〜かたがた (formal, greetings and visits) and 〜かたわら (two long-term activities).

formation_reference_en: Verb-dict / Noun + の + かたわら
meaning_reference_en: while also; alongside (one's main occupation)
notes_reference_en: Two activities pursued in parallel over a long period (a job and a side pursuit), not a one-off action. As a plain noun, かたわら also means 'beside'.

formation_reference_en: Verb-dict + が早いか
meaning_reference_en: the moment; no sooner ... than
notes_reference_en: The second action follows almost instantly; it states a past fact, never a request or intention. Near-synonyms: 〜や否や (most formal), 〜なり (same subject, often surprising), 〜そばから (repeated).

formation_reference_en: Noun (+ particle) + すら
meaning_reference_en: even; not even (an extreme example)
notes_reference_en: A more literary 〜さえ. Unlike さえ, it is not used in the 〜さえ〜ば ('if only') construction.

formation_reference_en: Noun + ずくめ
meaning_reference_en: nothing but; entirely; one ... after another
notes_reference_en: Works with a limited set of nouns (黒, いいこと, 規則, ごちそう, 結構). Unlike だらけ or まみれ it can be positive and does not mean physically covered.

formation_reference_en: Verb-ta + ら最後 / Verb-ta + が最後
meaning_reference_en: once ... (there's no going back); if ever ..., that's the end
notes_reference_en: The result is bad or irreversible and stated with certainty. 〜が最後 is slightly more literary.

formation_reference_en: Verb-te + からというもの
meaning_reference_en: ever since
notes_reference_en: Stresses a marked, lasting change that began with the event; more emotional than the neutral 〜て以来.

formation_reference_en: Verb-te + やまない
meaning_reference_en: never cease to; sincerely; deeply (hope, respect, love)
notes_reference_en: Used with verbs of feeling such as 願う, 祈る, 愛する, 尊敬する, 期待する. Typical of speeches, letters and formal writing.

formation_reference_en: Noun + と相まって / Noun + も相まって
meaning_reference_en: combined with; coupled with
notes_reference_en: Two factors reinforce each other to produce a stronger effect. Also AとBが相まって and 〜も相まって.

formation_reference_en: Noun / Verb-dict + ともなると / Noun / Verb-dict + ともなれば
meaning_reference_en: when it comes to; once (a certain level or stage) is reached
notes_reference_en: The noun marks a notably high status, time or amount; the rest states what naturally comes with it.

formation_reference_en: Noun + ならではの + Noun / Noun + ならではだ
meaning_reference_en: unique to; that only ... could offer
notes_reference_en: Almost always praise. The literary AならではBない means 'only A can B'.

formation_reference_en: Verb-dict + べく (する → すべく)
meaning_reference_en: in order to; with the aim of
notes_reference_en: Formal written style; する usually becomes すべく. The main clause cannot be a request or command.

formation_reference_en: Verb-volitional + ものなら
meaning_reference_en: if one were to (do), (something terrible would happen)
notes_reference_en: Exaggerates the danger of an action. Not to be confused with 〜ものなら (N2), which takes the potential form for an unlikely wish: 行けるものなら行きたい.

pattern: 〜に至る / 〜に至って / 〜に至っては
reading: 〜にいたる / 〜にいたって / 〜にいたっては
romaji: ni itaru / ni itatte / ni itatte wa
formation_reference_en: Noun / Verb-dict + に至る / Noun / Verb-dict + に至って / Noun + に至っては
meaning_reference_en: reach; lead to; only when it came to; as for (the most extreme case)
notes_reference_en: に至る: reach a (serious) point. に至って: only once things came to that. に至っては: introduces the most extreme example, usually negative. Related: 〜に至るまで 'down to, even'.

formation_reference_en: Noun + を禁じ得ない
meaning_reference_en: cannot help feeling; cannot suppress (an emotion)
notes_reference_en: Used with emotion nouns such as 怒り, 憤り, 同情, 驚き, 涙, 疑問. Formal; odd for trivial everyday feelings.

formation_reference_en: Noun + を余儀なくされる
meaning_reference_en: be forced to; have no choice but to
notes_reference_en: The noun is usually a suru-noun for an unwanted action (中止, 撤退, 変更, 入院). The active 〜を余儀なくさせる means 'force (someone) to'.

formation_reference_en: Noun + あっての + Noun / Noun + あってのことだ
meaning_reference_en: (only) possible because of; owe everything to
notes_reference_en: AあってのB: B exists only thanks to A, so A is indispensable. Often expresses gratitude.

formation_reference_en: Noun (+ の) + いかんで / Noun (+ の) + いかんによらず
meaning_reference_en: depending on; regardless of
notes_reference_en: Very formal (いかん = 'how, what'). Variants: 〜いかんによって / いかんでは (depending on); 〜いかんにかかわらず / いかんを問わず (regardless of).

formation_reference_en: Verb-volitional + が / Verb-volitional + と / i-Adj stem + かろうが / na-Adj + だろうが / Noun + だろうが
meaning_reference_en: no matter (what, how); even if
notes_reference_en: More emphatic than 〜ても; often with question words (何を, どこへ, いくら) or どんなに. The main clause shows the result is unaffected.

pattern: 〜(よ)うが〜まいが / 〜(よ)うと〜まいと
romaji: you ga ... mai ga / you to ... mai to
formation_reference_en: Verb-volitional + が + Verb-dict + まいが / Verb-volitional + と + Verb-dict + まいと
meaning_reference_en: whether or not; regardless of whether
notes_reference_en: The same verb is repeated. For ichidan verbs and する/来る, まい may attach to the nai-stem: 認めまい, しまい (or すまい), こまい.

formation_reference_en: Verb-volitional + にも + Verb-nai (potential of the same verb)
meaning_reference_en: want to (do) but can't; even if one tries, one cannot
notes_reference_en: Some outside circumstance blocks the intended action. The second verb is usually the negative potential of the same verb, or 〜ようがない.

formation_reference_en: i-Adj / na-Adj + な + かぎりだ
meaning_reference_en: extremely; I feel so (emotion)
notes_reference_en: Expresses the speaker's own strong feeling with emotion adjectives (うれしい, 寂しい, 心細い, うらやましい, 残念な). Not used for other people's feelings.

formation_reference_en: Noun + かたがた
meaning_reference_en: while also; partly for the purpose of
notes_reference_en: Formal; typically with お礼, ご挨拶, ご報告, お見舞い plus a verb of visiting (伺う, 訪ねる). Compare casual 〜がてら and 〜かたわら (parallel long-term activities).

formation_reference_en: Verb-plain / i-Adj / na-Adj / Noun + かと思いきや
meaning_reference_en: just when one thought ...; contrary to expectation
notes_reference_en: The outcome contradicts what was expected. Also 〜と思いきや. Found in lively writing and essays more than in speech.

formation_reference_en: Verb-dict / Verb-nai / Noun + の + きらいがある
meaning_reference_en: have a (bad) tendency to
notes_reference_en: Always critical; common in commentary about people's habits or institutions. Compare conversational 〜がち and neutral 〜傾向がある.

formation_reference_en: na-Adj + 極まる / na-Adj + 極まりない
meaning_reference_en: extremely; utterly
notes_reference_en: Both mean the same; 極まりない is more common today. Mostly with negative na-adjectives (失礼, 危険, 不愉快, 退屈). 感極まる 'be overcome with emotion' is a set phrase.

formation_reference_en: Noun + の極み
meaning_reference_en: the height of; the utmost
notes_reference_en: Common with 光栄, 感激, 痛恨, ぜいたく, 疲労. Compare 〜の至り, which is limited to a few set phrases about the speaker's own feelings.

formation_reference_en: Noun + の + ごとく / Verb-plain + (が) + ごとく / Noun + (の) + ごとき + Noun
meaning_reference_en: like; as; (after a person) the likes of
notes_reference_en: Literary equivalent of 〜ように / 〜ような. ごとき directly after a person shows contempt (お前ごとき) or, for oneself, humility (私ごとき).

formation_reference_en: Verb-plain / na-Adj + な / Noun + の + こととて
meaning_reference_en: because; since (as an excuse or apology)
notes_reference_en: Old-fashioned and formal, mainly in apologies or requests for understanding. Often with ぬ (知らぬこととて 'since I didn't know').

formation_reference_en: Verb-dict + ことなしに
meaning_reference_en: without (doing)
notes_reference_en: Often followed by an impossibility ('without A, B cannot happen'). Close to 〜ことなく (N2), which simply means 'without doing'.

formation_reference_en: Verb-dict + 始末だ / この + 始末だ
meaning_reference_en: end up (in a bad state); (things) have come to this
notes_reference_en: A bad outcome after a series of events, told with exasperation. Often with とうとう, ついには, 挙げ句の果てに.

formation_reference_en: Verb-nai stem + ずじまい (する → せずじまい)
meaning_reference_en: end up never doing; never got around to
notes_reference_en: Regret that an intended action never happened before the chance passed. Usually 〜ずじまいだった / 〜ずじまいになった.

pattern: 〜ずにはおかない / 〜ないではおかない
romaji: zu ni wa okanai / nai de wa okanai
formation_reference_en: Verb-nai stem + ずにはおかない (する → せずにはおかない) / Verb-nai + ではおかない
meaning_reference_en: will definitely (do); cannot fail to (cause a reaction)
notes_reference_en: Two uses: firm resolve, or something that inevitably causes a feeling or reaction. Compare 〜ずにはいられない (N2), one's own irresistible urge.

pattern: 〜ずにはすまない / 〜ないではすまない
romaji: zu ni wa sumanai / nai de wa sumanai
formation_reference_en: Verb-nai stem + ずにはすまない (する → せずにはすまない) / Verb-nai + ではすまない
meaning_reference_en: must (do); won't get away without (doing)
notes_reference_en: The obligation comes from social norms or the situation, not personal desire. 〜ずには済まされない is a stronger variant.

formation_reference_en: Verb-dict / Verb-ta + そばから
meaning_reference_en: as soon as (and again and again)
notes_reference_en: A repeated pattern where the second action undoes the first, often with frustration. Unlike 〜や否や or 〜なり, it is not used for a single one-off event.

formation_reference_en: Noun (一 + counter) + たりとも
meaning_reference_en: not even (one); not a single
notes_reference_en: Attaches to 一 + counter (一円, 一日, 一人, 一瞬) and is followed by a negative or prohibition. Also 何人たりとも 'no one whatsoever'.

formation_reference_en: Verb-dict + だに / Noun + だに
meaning_reference_en: even (just); not even
notes_reference_en: Archaic; survives mainly in set phrases: 想像するだに / 考えるだに ('just thinking about it'), 微動だにしない, 想像だにしない / 夢想だにしない ('never even imagine').

formation_reference_en: Noun + たる + Noun / Noun + たるもの
meaning_reference_en: as (one in the position of); befitting
notes_reference_en: Stresses the duties or dignity expected of a role. 〜たる者 / 〜たるもの is followed by what such a person should (not) do.

formation_reference_en: Verb-stem + つ + Verb-stem + つ
meaning_reference_en: (doing) A and B alternately; back and forth
notes_reference_en: Only in set phrases with opposite verbs or active/passive pairs: 行きつ戻りつ, 持ちつ持たれつ, 抜きつ抜かれつ, 浮きつ沈みつ.

romaji: de are / de are ... de are
formation_reference_en: Noun + であれ / Question word + であれ / Noun + であれ + Noun + であれ
meaning_reference_en: whatever (it is); whoever; whether A or B
notes_reference_en: Written equivalent of 〜でも / 〜だろうと. 〜であろうと and 〜であろうが are close variants.

formation_reference_en: Verb-te + しかるべきだ / i-Adj-ku + て + しかるべきだ / na-Adj + であって + しかるべきだ
meaning_reference_en: ought to; it would only be natural to
notes_reference_en: States what would be proper, often in the passive and often implying criticism that it hasn't happened. The adjective しかるべき also means 'appropriate'.

formation_reference_en: Noun + ではあるまいし / Verb-dict + の + ではあるまいし
meaning_reference_en: it's not as if (one were); since (one) is not
notes_reference_en: Followed by a judgment, advice or command. Despite the formal まい, it's common in speech, especially as 〜じゃあるまいし.

formation_reference_en: Verb-plain / Noun + の + 手前
meaning_reference_en: since (considering how it looks to others); out of consideration for
notes_reference_en: Because of what one has said or one's position in front of others, one feels bound to act a certain way. Often followed by 〜わけにはいかない or 〜しかない.

formation_reference_en: Verb-te + もさしつかえない / i-Adj-ku + て + もさしつかえない / na-Adj + でもさしつかえない / Noun + でもさしつかえない
meaning_reference_en: it's all right to; there's no problem if
notes_reference_en: A more formal 〜てもいい / 〜ても構わない, common in business, notices and official instructions. Often written 差し支えない.

formation_reference_en: Verb-plain / i-Adj / na-Adj / Noun + とあって
meaning_reference_en: because (of a special situation); as it is
notes_reference_en: The cause is a special, noteworthy situation, and the main clause reports its natural, observed result. Common in news; not used for the speaker's own wishes or requests.

formation_reference_en: Verb-plain / Noun + とあれば
meaning_reference_en: if it's (for); if (such a special case) is so
notes_reference_en: A special condition under which one would make an exception or do something difficult. Frequently 〜のためとあれば.

formation_reference_en: Noun + といい + Noun + といい
meaning_reference_en: both A and B; in terms of A as well as B
notes_reference_en: Picks out two aspects as evidence for an overall evaluation, positive or negative. Unlike plain 〜も〜も, it carries the speaker's judgment.

formation_reference_en: Noun / Verb-dict + といったところだ
meaning_reference_en: at most; about; more or less
notes_reference_en: A rough, modest estimate: the amount or level isn't large. Often with せいぜい or まあ. Also 〜というところだ.

formation_reference_en: Verb-plain / i-Adj / na-Adj / Noun + といえども
meaning_reference_en: even though; even (someone like)
notes_reference_en: Formal version of 〜といっても / 〜であっても: even someone with that status is not exempt. Often with いかなる or たとえ.

formation_reference_en: i-Adj / na-Adj / Noun + といったらない
meaning_reference_en: indescribably; extremely; beyond words
notes_reference_en: Works for both positive and negative feelings. Casual forms: 〜ったらない, and 〜といったらありゃしない (negative only).

formation_reference_en: Noun + ときたら
meaning_reference_en: when it comes to; as for (complaint)
notes_reference_en: Introduces a familiar person or thing the speaker is fed up with; what follows is a complaint. Conversational.

pattern: 〜としたところで / 〜にしたところで
romaji: to shita tokoro de / ni shita tokoro de
formation_reference_en: Verb-plain / Noun + としたところで / Noun + にしたところで
meaning_reference_en: even if; even supposing; even for (someone)
notes_reference_en: Like 〜としても / 〜にしても, but stresses that the outcome won't change. Casual: 〜としたって / 〜にしたって.

formation_reference_en: Verb-plain / i-Adj / na-Adj / Noun + とは
meaning_reference_en: (to think) that ...!; I'm surprised that
notes_reference_en: Can end the sentence, leaving the reaction unsaid, or be followed by 思わなかった, 驚いた, etc. Different from definitional 〜とは ('X means ...').

formation_reference_en: Sentence + とばかりに
meaning_reference_en: as if to say
notes_reference_en: Describes someone else's attitude or gesture that seems to say something without words; not used about oneself. Compare 〜んばかり (a nearly-reached extreme state).

romaji: to mo naku / to mo nashi ni
formation_reference_en: Verb-dict + ともなく / Verb-dict + ともなしに / Question word + (particle) + ともなく
meaning_reference_en: without meaning to; idly; (with question words) no particular
notes_reference_en: The same verb is usually repeated (見るともなく見る). With question words: どこからともなく 'from nowhere in particular', 誰からともなく 'someone or other'.

formation_reference_en: Verb-nai + までも
meaning_reference_en: even if not (to that extent), at least
notes_reference_en: The first part names a high level not reached; the second a lower, acceptable level, often with せめて, 少なくとも or advice.

formation_reference_en: Verb-nai + ものでもない
meaning_reference_en: it's not impossible that; might (under some conditions)
notes_reference_en: A roundabout, somewhat reluctant way to admit a possibility. Similar to 〜ないことはない (N3) but stiffer.

formation_reference_en: Noun + ながらに / Noun + ながらの + Noun / Verb-stem + ながらに
meaning_reference_en: as (it was); while remaining; since (birth)
notes_reference_en: Limited to set expressions: 昔ながら, 涙ながら, 生まれながら, いつもながら, いながらにして ('without leaving one's place').

formation_reference_en: Noun + なくして(は)
meaning_reference_en: without (something essential), (cannot)
notes_reference_en: Followed by a negative or impossibility; stresses that the noun is indispensable. More emphatic and literary than 〜なしに(は).

formation_reference_en: Noun + なしに(は)
meaning_reference_en: without
notes_reference_en: なしに simply means 'without'; なしには is followed by a negative ('can't ... without'). Conversation often uses 〜なしで.

pattern: 〜ならいざしらず / 〜はいざしらず
romaji: nara iza shirazu / wa iza shirazu
formation_reference_en: Noun + ならいざしらず / Noun + はいざしらず / Verb-plain + (の) + ならいざしらず
meaning_reference_en: it may be different for ..., but; I don't know about ..., but
notes_reference_en: The first case could be excused or is unknown; the actual case is judged more strictly. Close to 〜ならまだしも, but more literary.

formation_reference_en: Noun + ならまだしも / Verb-plain + (の) + ならまだしも
meaning_reference_en: if it were ..., it would be one thing (but)
notes_reference_en: The first case is just about tolerable; the real situation is worse. More conversational than 〜ならいざしらず. Variant: 〜はまだしも.

formation_reference_en: Verb-dict + なり
meaning_reference_en: as soon as; the moment
notes_reference_en: Both actions are by the same (usually third-person) subject, and the second is often unexpected. Not for the speaker's own actions or future plans. Differs from 〜なり〜なり and 〜なりに.

formation_reference_en: Noun + なり + Noun + なり / Verb-dict + なり + Verb-dict + なり
meaning_reference_en: either A or B; A or B or whatever
notes_reference_en: Gives sample options and is usually followed by a suggestion, request or command, not a past event. A single 〜なり can mean 'or something' (お茶なり).

formation_reference_en: Noun + なりに / Noun + なりの + Noun / i-Adj + なりに / Verb-plain + なりに
meaning_reference_en: in one's own way; as far as (one's limits) allow
notes_reference_en: Accepts a limitation (age, ability, size) and says something is done or valued within it. Can sound condescending if used about a superior.

formation_reference_en: Verb-dict + には当たらない / Noun + には当たらない
meaning_reference_en: there's no need to; it's not worth (being surprised, etc.)
notes_reference_en: Used with verbs of reaction: 驚く, 責める, 非難する, 心配する, 悲しむ, 賞賛する. The situation doesn't warrant that reaction.

formation_reference_en: Noun + にあって(は / も)
meaning_reference_en: in (a situation or position); at (a time)
notes_reference_en: A formal 〜で / 〜において that stresses being in a special situation. にあっても = 'even in'; にあっては = 'in (such a position)'.

formation_reference_en: Verb-dict + に難くない / Noun + に難くない
meaning_reference_en: it's not hard to (imagine, understand)
notes_reference_en: Limited to a few words: 想像, 理解, 察する, 予想. Formal written style.

formation_reference_en: Noun + にして
meaning_reference_en: only (at/with); even for; being both A and B
notes_reference_en: Main uses: a stage reached, often 〜にして初めて ('only at/with'); 'even for (someone exceptional)' (名人にしてなお解けない); and AにしてB 'both A and B'.

formation_reference_en: Noun + に即して / Noun + に即した + Noun
meaning_reference_en: in accordance with; based on (the facts, actual conditions)
notes_reference_en: Typical nouns: 事実, 実情, 現実, 実態, 状況. With laws or rules, 〜に則して or 〜に則って is used.

formation_reference_en: Verb-dict + に堪える / Noun + に堪える / Verb-dict + に堪えない / Noun + に堪えない
meaning_reference_en: be worth (doing); unbearable to (see, hear); (feel) deeply
notes_reference_en: に堪える: 'worth (reading, seeing)'. Verb + に堪えない: 'too awful to (see, hear)'. Emotion noun + に堪えない (感謝, 遺憾): 'feel deeply', in formal speech.

formation_reference_en: Verb-dict + に足る + Noun / Noun + に足る + Noun
meaning_reference_en: worthy of; sufficient to
notes_reference_en: Mostly before a noun (信頼に足る人物). The negative 取るに足らない ('trivial') is a common set phrase.

formation_reference_en: Noun / Verb-plain + にとどまらず
meaning_reference_en: not limited to; not stopping at; going beyond
notes_reference_en: Stresses that something spreads beyond an expected scope or area. Close to 〜に限らず (N2) but with a stronger sense of expansion.

formation_reference_en: Noun + にひきかえ / Verb-plain + の + にひきかえ
meaning_reference_en: in contrast to; unlike
notes_reference_en: Contrasts two opposite things with the speaker's evaluation (one good, one bad). More subjective than 〜に対して.

formation_reference_en: Noun + にもまして / Question word + にもまして
meaning_reference_en: even more than; above all
notes_reference_en: Often 以前にもまして, 例年にもまして. With a question word (何にもまして, 誰にもまして) it means 'more than anything / anyone'.

formation_reference_en: Noun + の至り
meaning_reference_en: utmost; the height of (in set phrases)
notes_reference_en: Mostly in set phrases: 光栄の至り, 恐縮の至り, 感激の至り, and 若気の至り ('youthful folly'). Used in formal speeches and letters.

formation_reference_en: Noun / Verb-plain / i-Adj + のみならず / na-Adj + である + のみならず / Noun + である + のみならず
meaning_reference_en: not only ... but also
notes_reference_en: Formal written equivalent of 〜だけでなく / 〜ばかりでなく. Can also open a sentence: のみならず、…

formation_reference_en: Noun + はおろか
meaning_reference_en: let alone; not to mention
notes_reference_en: AはおろかBも / さえ / まで: B is an even more basic case; usually about negative or surprising facts. Unlike 〜どころか, not used with commands or wishes.

formation_reference_en: Verb-ba + こそ / i-Adj stem + ければこそ / na-Adj + であればこそ / Noun + であればこそ
meaning_reference_en: precisely because; only because
notes_reference_en: Stresses a positive or well-meant reason, often to explain something that might be misunderstood. More literary than 〜からこそ.

formation_reference_en: Verb-ba + それまでだ
meaning_reference_en: if ..., that's the end of it; it's all for nothing if
notes_reference_en: Two uses: all effort is wasted if X happens; or 〜と言ってしまえばそれまでだ, 'saying X ends the discussion (but ...)'. Often with 〜てしまえば.

formation_reference_en: Verb-dict + べからず / Verb-dict + べからざる + Noun (する → すべからず)
meaning_reference_en: must not; do not (on signs); (before a noun) must not be
notes_reference_en: Archaic; mainly on signs, in rules and in set phrases. べからざる before a noun appears in 欠くべからざる ('indispensable') and 許すべからざる ('unforgivable').

formation_reference_en: Verb-dict + べくもない (する → すべくもない)
meaning_reference_en: cannot possibly; there's no way to
notes_reference_en: Common with 望む, 知る, 比べる (also classical 比ぶべくもない). Literary; the impossibility comes from circumstances.

formation_reference_en: Noun + に + あるまじき + Noun / Verb-dict + まじき + Noun
meaning_reference_en: unacceptable for (someone in that position); should not
notes_reference_en: Mostly as 〜にあるまじき / 〜としてあるまじき + 行為, 発言, 態度: behavior unworthy of a role. Strongly critical and formal.

formation_reference_en: Verb-dict + までもない
meaning_reference_en: needless to; there's no need to (go as far as)
notes_reference_en: The matter is too obvious or minor to need the action. 言うまでもなく ('needless to say') is a common set phrase.

romaji: made da / made no koto da
formation_reference_en: Verb-dict + までだ / Verb-ta + までだ / Verb-dict + までのことだ
meaning_reference_en: (I'll) just (do); I merely (did)
notes_reference_en: With Verb-dict: calm resolve to take the only remaining option. With Verb-ta: 'I only did X, nothing more', justifying one's action.

formation_reference_en: Noun + まみれ
meaning_reference_en: covered in; smeared with
notes_reference_en: Something (mud, blood, sweat, oil, dust, debt) sticks all over. Compare だらけ (lots of scattered things, even mistakes) and ずくめ (entirely, can be positive).

formation_reference_en: Noun + めく / Noun + めいた + Noun
meaning_reference_en: show signs of; become like; -ish
notes_reference_en: Limited to certain nouns: 春めく, 秋めく, 謎めく, 皮肉めく, 冗談めく, 言い訳めく. More literary than 〜らしい / 〜っぽい.

formation_reference_en: Noun + もさることながら
meaning_reference_en: not only ... but also (even more); ... aside
notes_reference_en: Acknowledges A, then stresses B as even more important or notable. Usually positive evaluations.

formation_reference_en: Verb-plain / i-Adj / na-Adj + な + ものを
meaning_reference_en: if only (..., but); although (regret or reproach)
notes_reference_en: Regret, dissatisfaction or reproach that things didn't go as they could have. Often with 〜ば / 〜たら; can end the sentence: 言ってくれればよかったものを.

formation_reference_en: Verb-dict + や否や / Verb-dict + や
meaning_reference_en: as soon as; the moment; no sooner ... than
notes_reference_en: The most written of the 'as soon as' group; past facts only, not intentions or commands. Also shortened to 〜や. Compare 〜なり (same subject) and 〜そばから (repeated).

formation_reference_en: Noun + (の) + ゆえ(に) / Verb-plain + (が) + ゆえ(に) / i-Adj + (が) + ゆえ(に) / na-Adj + である + がゆえに
meaning_reference_en: because of; due to; therefore
notes_reference_en: Formal written 'because'; 〜がゆえに is emphatic and 〜ゆえの + Noun modifies a noun. At the start of a sentence, ゆえに means 'therefore' (logic, math).

formation_reference_en: Noun + をおいて(ほかに)〜ない
meaning_reference_en: other than; apart from (no one / nothing else)
notes_reference_en: Praises something as the only possible choice; followed by a negative (いない, ない). Unrelated to 置いて 'leave behind'.

formation_reference_en: Noun + を皮切りに / Verb-plain + の + を皮切りに
meaning_reference_en: starting with; beginning with (followed by a series)
notes_reference_en: Marks the first of a series of similar events that expand or spread. Also 〜を皮切りとして.

formation_reference_en: Noun + を機に / Verb-plain + の + を機に
meaning_reference_en: taking the opportunity of; with (an event) as a turning point
notes_reference_en: More formal than 〜をきっかけに (N2), usually for a significant turning point. Also 〜を機として.

formation_reference_en: Noun + を限りに
meaning_reference_en: as of (and no longer); for the last time; at the top of (one's voice)
notes_reference_en: Marks the last point before something ends (本日を限りに, 今回を限りに). 声を限りに 'as loud as one can' is a set phrase.

formation_reference_en: Noun + をもって
meaning_reference_en: with; by means of; as of (a time)
notes_reference_en: Two uses: means (書面をもって, 実力をもって) and a formal end point (本日をもって). 〜をもちまして is common in announcements; 〜をもってすれば = 'with ..., (anything is possible)'.

formation_reference_en: Noun + をものともせず(に)
meaning_reference_en: in defiance of; undaunted by
notes_reference_en: Admiring description of someone else overcoming a hardship; not used about oneself. Compare 〜をよそに (disregarding others' concern, often critical).

formation_reference_en: Noun + をよそに
meaning_reference_en: ignoring; paying no heed to; oblivious to
notes_reference_en: The noun is usually others' feelings or reactions (心配, 期待, 反対, 批判) that the subject disregards; often mildly critical.

formation_reference_en: Verb-nai stem + んがため(に) (する → せんがため)
meaning_reference_en: in order to; for the sake of (strong resolve)
notes_reference_en: Archaic and emphatic, expressing strong determination; not for trivial goals. 〜んがための + Noun modifies a noun.

formation_reference_en: Verb-nai stem + んばかり (する → せんばかり)
meaning_reference_en: as if about to; almost (to the point of)
notes_reference_en: A state so extreme something seems about to happen, though it doesn't. Forms: 〜んばかりに, 〜んばかりだ, 〜んばかりの + Noun. 言わんばかり overlaps with 〜とばかりに.

formation_reference_en: Verb-dict / Verb-ta + うえは
meaning_reference_en: now that; since (one must)
notes_reference_en: Like 〜以上(は) and 〜からには (N2) but stiffer; the second half expresses resolve, obligation or advice. Also written 上は.

formation_reference_en: ただ + Noun + のみ / ただ + Verb-dict + のみ
meaning_reference_en: only; just; nothing but
notes_reference_en: Formal version of ただ〜だけ. Often ends a sentence as 〜のみだ ('all one can do is ...'). のみ alone also means 'only' in written style.

formation_reference_en: Noun / Verb-plain / i-Adj / na-Adj + だの + ... + だの
meaning_reference_en: things like A and B (complaining list)
notes_reference_en: Lists examples with annoyance or disapproval, often followed by と(言う). Compare neutral 〜やら〜やら (N2) and 〜とか〜とか.

formation_reference_en: Verb-te + はばからない
meaning_reference_en: not hesitate to; openly (say, declare)
notes_reference_en: With verbs of speaking (言う, 公言する, 断言する); often implies the boldness is excessive. Usually about a third person.

formation_reference_en: Noun + ともあろう + Noun
meaning_reference_en: of all people; someone (of such standing) as
notes_reference_en: The noun is a respected role or institution; the sentence criticizes behavior unworthy of it. Usually 〜ともあろう者が / 人が.

formation_reference_en: Noun + にかこつけて
meaning_reference_en: using (something) as an excuse or pretext
notes_reference_en: The stated reason is a pretext for what the person really wants to do. Close to 〜を口実に.

formation_reference_en: Noun + に言わせれば / Noun + に言わせると
meaning_reference_en: if you ask (someone); in (someone's) opinion
notes_reference_en: Introduces a personal, strongly held opinion that may differ from others'. Unlike neutral 〜によれば, it stresses the individual's view.

formation_reference_en: Noun + にかまけて
meaning_reference_en: being too wrapped up in (to attend to other things)
notes_reference_en: The main clause names something neglected as a result; often self-critical or an excuse.

formation_reference_en: Verb-ta + かいもなく / Noun + の + かいもなく
meaning_reference_en: despite (efforts); to no avail
notes_reference_en: The effort did not pay off. The positive counterpart 〜かいがあって means 'the effort was worth it'. Also written 甲斐もなく.

formation_reference_en: Noun + きっての + Noun
meaning_reference_en: the most ... in; the best in
notes_reference_en: The noun is a group or place (社内, 町内, 学校, 業界, 国内). Used for praise, usually of a person or an establishment.

formation_reference_en: Verb-nai stem + ずとも (する → せずとも)
meaning_reference_en: even without; without having to
notes_reference_en: Literary version of 〜なくても. 〜ずともよい means 'need not'.

formation_reference_en: Verb-plain / i-Adj / na-Adj / Noun + とはいえ
meaning_reference_en: although; even though; that said
notes_reference_en: Admits a fact, then says the expected result doesn't fully follow. Can open a sentence ('that said'). More formal than 〜といっても.

formation_reference_en: Verb-dict + べくして + Verb-ta (same verb)
meaning_reference_en: as was bound to happen; inevitably
notes_reference_en: The same verb is repeated (起こるべくして起こる); the outcome was the natural consequence of the circumstances.

formation_reference_en: Noun + じみる / Noun + じみた + Noun
meaning_reference_en: smack of; seem like (in a bad way); -ish
notes_reference_en: Negative nuance: 子どもじみた, 年寄りじみた, 説教じみた, 芝居じみた. Compare neutral 〜めく and casual 〜っぽい. With 汗 or 油 it means 'stained with'.

formation_reference_en: Noun + ぐるみ
meaning_reference_en: including all; the whole (group) together
notes_reference_en: Works with a limited set of nouns: 家族, 町, 地域, 会社, 組織, 身ぐるみ. 会社ぐるみ / 組織ぐるみ often describe organized wrongdoing.

formation_reference_en: Noun / na-Adj / i-Adj / Verb-dict + にもほどがある
meaning_reference_en: there's a limit to; too ... (beyond what's acceptable)
notes_reference_en: Strong criticism or indignation that something has gone too far. Conversational and emotional.

formation_reference_en: Noun + をいいことに / Verb-plain + の + をいいことに
meaning_reference_en: taking (unfair) advantage of; using (a situation) as license to
notes_reference_en: Critical: someone exploits a situation to do something improper. For a neutral 'taking the opportunity', use 〜を機に or 〜をきっかけに.

formation_reference_en: Noun + に則って / Noun + に則った + Noun
meaning_reference_en: in accordance with (rules, law, tradition)
notes_reference_en: The noun is a norm or model: 法律, 規則, 伝統, しきたり, 手順. Compare 〜に即して, used with facts and actual conditions.

formation_reference_en: i-Adj stem + かれ + i-Adj stem + かれ
meaning_reference_en: whether A or B; A or B alike (fixed pairs)
notes_reference_en: A classical adjective form surviving only in fixed opposite pairs: 遅かれ早かれ, 多かれ少なかれ, 良かれあしかれ. Not productive.

formation_reference_en: i-Adj + ことこの上ない / na-Adj + な + ことこの上ない
meaning_reference_en: extremely; nothing could be more
notes_reference_en: A stiff, written way to say 'extremely'. Also この上ない + Noun (この上ない喜び 'the greatest joy'). Close to 〜極まりない.

formation_reference_en: Verb-plain / i-Adj / na-Adj / Noun + とみえる / Verb-plain / i-Adj / na-Adj / Noun + とみえて
meaning_reference_en: it seems (judging from evidence); apparently
notes_reference_en: An inference from what one observes; with 〜とみえて the observed evidence follows. More literary than 〜らしい / 〜ようだ. Also written と見える.

formation_reference_en: Noun + を踏まえて / Noun + を踏まえた + Noun
meaning_reference_en: based on; taking into account; in light of
notes_reference_en: Common in business and official writing. Unlike 〜に基づいて (N2), which follows a basis closely, it means building on or reflecting something.

formation_reference_en: Verb-nai + とも限らない
meaning_reference_en: it's not impossible that; there's a chance that
notes_reference_en: Warns of a small but real possibility, usually undesirable, and is often followed by a precaution. Different from 〜とは限らない ('not necessarily').
